committee: POSTPONED - PRESENTATION for Certificate No. 469-38 (LS): 2026-2027 ISA All-Island Cross Country Championship-Senator Vincent A.V. Borja
location: Guam Congress Building Public Hearing Room
title: Håfa Adai! Please be advised that on Monday, November 9, 2026 , at 3:00 P.M., at the Guam Congress Building Public Hearing Room , Senator Vincent A.V. Borja will present postpone Certificate No. 469-38 (LS) , recognizing the Okkodo Bulldogs Boys and John F. Kennedy Islanders Girls Athletes and Coaches for their dedication to the sport of Cross Country; and to congratulate them as the winners of the 2026-2027 ISA All-Island Cross Country Championship. The presentation will be rescheduled to a later date. We look forward to your participation. 11.6.26 3:17pm (FN) 11/9/26 10:27 AM (RR)
